cases.question: Compare the approval validity periods in Willow Access v1.md and Willow Access v2.md.
cases.answer: The approval validity period in Willow Access v1.md is twenty-four minutes, whereas in Willow Access v2.md, it is thirteen minutes. This difference is stated in the selected evidence, specifically in [1] Willow Access v1.md (page 1) and [3] Willow Access v2.md.

citations.text:
# Willow Access Policy Version 1

Historical rule: an access approval remained valid for twenty-four minutes and could be reused before expiry. Version 2 replaces this rule for new approvals.

# Willow Access Policy Version 2

This policy replaces Version 1 for new approvals.
